turns.text: Hey Lloyd, can you check the status of the Conversation Relation Linking module? I think it's stuck in the review queue.
I'm looking into it. It seems to be in a pending state. Do you have specific metrics you're tracking?
Yeah, just want to see how much backlog we have. Currently, Conversation Relation Linking (#51) has 900 total pending proposals (130 strong, 770 moderate).
Got it. That is a significant backlog. I'll note that down for your weekly report.
Thanks. By the way, did you see the weather forecast for next week? Looks like rain.
Yes, I saw that. High chance of precipitation starting Tuesday. You might want to bring an umbrella.
Good point. Also, my keyboard is acting up again. The 'k' key is sticky.
Oh no. Have you tried cleaning it with compressed air? That usually helps with sticky keys.
Lloyd, update on the pipeline? I'm worried about the confidence scores.
I checked the logs. There was an issue with the recent batch processing.
Right, I noticed Stage 2 of Conversation Relation Linking was skipped because max confidence (0.70) was below the 0.80 threshold.
That explains the gap in the data. We need to adjust the threshold or improve the model.
Agreed. I'll schedule a meeting for Thursday to discuss.
Sounds good. I'll send the invite.
Also, did you order the new monitor?
Yes, it shipped today. Should arrive by Friday.
Perfect. I need to set it up before the weekend.
I'll remind you on Friday morning.
